rationale: The original breakdown below $58.00 failed immediately (0.00% MFE), and TEX has reclaimed both the $58.00 level and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($58.39) alongside an improving macro tape (SPY recovering from -1.26% to -1.01%). With price now pressing $58.56 against a wide 37.6 bps spread ($58.38 x $58.60) and the $58.68 invalidation level just above the ask, initiating a close allows the execution algorithm to try working passively near the $58.38 bid rather than guaranteeing an aggressive market stop-out across the wide spread.
